about: WP-T1's acceptance set (spec 40, revision 6; the revision-4 amendment of WP-T1): the 807 physically possible limp starts of the V1 at placement B, each judged as its activation glide - the straight joint line to HOME with the claw blended from claw_start to claw_end - against TOWER_T1_PARTS with the driver's allowance. 605 are refused (column 80, block 115, head 398, lens 12), every one fallen back (joint 2 <= 0.30 rad); none of the 93 placed starts (joint 2 > 0.5 rad), the smallest of their margins 30.1 mm.
starts_from: scratch/architect/r4/out/p42_X0.575.npz: the 880 starts of verify-cam's v50 at the B tower, the 807 not inside a tower part
refused_from: scratch/r6/out/p08_wpt1_gabs.json out.r4.refused_starts (equal to p20b_wpt1_lens.json's set, the revision-4 lens box)
margin_from: physical_ai_server/workflow/fixture_guard.TowerGuard on TOWER_T1_PARTS at the contract place, TOWER_RESIDUAL_DRIVER_M, the V1's design droop envelope and kappa, the claw in 0.1 rad bands, every part at every dense sample: the smallest margin of the glide and its part (scratch/build-WP-T1/ref_server.py)
range_note: the starts' own joint range (the claw's window last), which the glides are judged in: joint 2 reaches 3.1416 and joint 4 -1.92, values the servo's EEPROM window (tick 4095 = 3.14006 rad; joint 4 +-1.92054) does not reach or that lie beyond the URDF limits
